content_sections.heading: GMCH Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download GMCH notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.s.c Degree/ Diploma (MLT/DMLT) in Pathology / Preferably three years of post-qualification experience in clinical research, multicentre research projects/ field + Two years experience in relevant subject/ Field. Experience: Preferably three years of post-qualification experience in clinical research, multicentre research projects/ field + Two years experience in relevant subject/ Field Other conditions: May have to work in emergency situations, field visits and travel outstation In-service candidates must submit NOC from present employer, failing which application is liable for rejection Desirable: Preferably three years of post-qualification experience in clinical research, multicentre research projects/ field

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration of post 3 years (renewable after 1 year) Appointment purely on contract basis (temporary in nature) No right to claim regular appointment, permanent absorption or continued contractual appointment PI has right to cancel the candidature at any time Leave as per Institutional Policy for Project staff, at the discretion of PI

rows.event: Last date of receipt of application (hard copies by 5 p.m.)

content_sections.heading: How Will GMCH Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written screening exam / aptitude test (if needed) Interview in the office of Professor-in-charge Academic Merit list on the basis of CGPA and experience If applicants exceed 10, an aptitude test is held Originals to be produced during the interview for verification Written screening exam and interview dates will be updated on website

content_sections.heading: GMCH Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Aptitude test will be conducted if number of applicants is more than 10.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Brief Curriculum Vitae (in the application form attached) Date of Birth Certificate Essential qualification certificates Experience certificate No Objection Certificate from present employer, if currently employed One passport size photo

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMCH Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed application form attached to the notice. Attach self-attested copies of certificates listed in the notice. Submit to Department of Neonatology (Room No. D-403), Level-IV, Block-D, GMCH, Sector-32, Chandigarh. Hard copies must reach on or before 2nd Dec 2026 at 5 p.m.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Technical Support III.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form attached on page 3 of the notice) and send it to Department of Neonatology (Room No. D-403), Level-IV, Block-D, GMCH, Sector-32, Chandigarh, by by hand or post, to reach by 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 33,600 per month (Rs. 28,000 + 20% HRA).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc Degree/ Diploma (MLT/DMLT) in Pathology; preferably three years of post-qualification experience in clinical research, multicentre research projects/ field + two years experience in relevant subject/ field.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. May have to work in emergency situations, field visits and travel outstation. In-service candidates must submit NOC from present employer, failing which application is liable for rejection.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written screening exam / aptitude test (if needed). Interview in the office of Professor-in-charge Academic. Merit list on the basis of CGPA and experience. If applicants exceed 10, an aptitude test is held.

faq.answer: Duration of post 3 years (renewable after 1 year). Appointment purely on contract basis (temporary in nature). No right to claim regular appointment, permanent absorption or continued contractual appointment.

faq.answer: Department of Neonatology, GMCH, Sector-32, Chandigarh.
